description.text: Program Description Engineering management is a new interdisciplinary subject of engineering technology and management. This major cultivates compound senior management talents who have basic knowledge of management, economics and civil engineering technology, and master theories, methods and methods of modern management science. Project management consists of engineering management major, awarded bachelor's degree in management or engineering, the future can be engaged in engineering construction and real estate industry at home and abroad project decision, project investment and financing, project management and management of the whole process.

duration.text: The Engineering and Project Management at Beijing Jiaotong University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of bachelor school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of bachelor school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. Bachelor's degree 3. Be in good health condition
